CREATE TABLE spoolman_import_source (
	source_instance_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	device_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	display_name TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at TEXT NOT NULL, 
	last_seen_at TEXT NOT NULL, 
	snapshot_sha256 TEXT, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_spoolman_import_source PRIMARY KEY (source_instance_key), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_spoolman_import_source_source_key_format CHECK (length(source_instance_key) IN (24, 32) AND source_instance_key NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_spoolman_import_source_display_name_length CHECK (length(display_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 200), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_spoolman_import_source_timestamps_valid CHECK (length(created_at) = 27 AND length(last_seen_at) = 27 AND last_seen_at >= created_at), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_spoolman_import_source_snapshot_digest_format CHECK (snapshot_sha256 IS NULL OR (length(snapshot_sha256) = 64 AND snapshot_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_spoolman_import_source_device_id UNIQUE (device_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_spoolman_import_source_device_id_device_identity FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES device_identity (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
)

WITH parsed AS (
    SELECT actor_device_id AS device_id,
           substr(correlation_id, 10,
               instr(substr(correlation_id, 10), ':spool:') - 1) AS source_instance_key,
           created_at
      FROM audit_event
     WHERE event_code = 'spool.created'
       AND correlation_id LIKE 'spoolman:%:spool:%:create'
), legacy_sources AS (
    SELECT device_id, source_instance_key,
           MIN(created_at) AS created_at, MAX(created_at) AS last_seen_at
      FROM parsed
     WHERE length(source_instance_key) = 24
       AND source_instance_key NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
     GROUP BY device_id, source_instance_key
)
INSERT INTO spoolman_import_source (
    source_instance_key, device_id, display_name, created_at, last_seen_at, snapshot_sha256
)
SELECT source_instance_key, device_id,
       'Legacy Spoolman import (' || substr(source_instance_key, 1, 8) || ')',
       created_at, last_seen_at, NULL
  FROM legacy_sources
 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM device_identity d WHERE d.id = legacy_sources.device_id)
ON CONFLICT(source_instance_key) DO NOTHING
